chapter: Sinatra, Shirley Horn and film songs
title: How The Shadow of Your Smile became a song
summary: Mandel says the Sandpiper theme was demoed on piano before scoring and then turned into a song.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: So, Sandpiper of course was the film from which “Shadow of Your Smile” emerged.
Yes it was, it was originally instrumental theme and then we got…
It was, “Love Theme from The Sandpiper,” right?
When did they decide to add lyrics in?

After I'd done it. Actually we had decided before that. I had the song in piano form and demoed it, ‘cause they wanted to hear the theme before I ever put it to score, and that was when we decided to make a song out of it.
